study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative modelling of brain morphometry across the lifespan with CentileBrain: algorithm benchmarking and model optimisation

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Data from 87 datasets (including ENIGMA consortium datasets and publicly available datasets) were used for normative modeling. HCP-EP was used for testing clinical relevance.

Healthy Brain Network/CMI... HCP Adult Brain... HCP Aging... HCP Development... MCIC... Rockland... StrokeMRI... UK BIOBANK... HCP-EP cohort comprises 91 individuals...

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: 87 datasets were used to develop standard normative models (split 80/20 for training/testing). HCP-EP was used to test clinical relevance.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: We collated de-identified data from 87 datasets... split into a training subset (80%) and a test subset (20%)... We tested whether normative brain regional Z-scores have an advantage... using psychosis as an example... HCP-EP cohort...
